question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-x+2y &=6 \\ 2x-3y &=13 \\ 5x-y &=45\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 2 & -3 & 13 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 2 & -3 & 13 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 0 & 9 & 75\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-9){R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 0 & 0 & -150\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

The final row corresponds to the equation $0x+0y=-150,$ and this has no solution. Therefore, our system has no solution, and we conclude that the system is inconsistent.

As a result, only statement “The system is inconsistent” is true.

M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 1 & 0 \\ -4 & 6 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 1 & 0 \\ -4 & 6 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -6 & 4 & 2\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variables are $x$ and $y,$ and we have one free variable, $z.$ That means we can to find $x$ and $y$ in terms of $z.$ 

Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*. 

As a result, only statement “The system is consistent dependent” is true.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}2x+3y &=-1 \\ x-2y &=1 \\ -x-5y &=2.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first try to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is 

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 3 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 3 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & -1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & -7 & 3\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Since any numbers $x$ and $y$ are solutions to the third equation $0x+0y=0$, we can remove this equation from the system. So, the corresponding system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y &=1 \\ 7y &=-3.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the second equation, we get $y=-\frac{3}{7}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we get

$$
x-2\left(-\frac{3}{7}\right)=1\,⟹\,x=\frac{1}{7}.
$$

 
So, we conclude that the system is consistent independent. 

As a result, only statement “The system is consistent independent” is true.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3x+2y &=8 \\ x+y &=-2 \\ x+\frac{1}{2}y &=5.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first try to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & \frac{1}{2} & 5\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & \frac{1}{2} & 5\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 2 & 8 \\ 1 & \frac{1}{2} & 5\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & 14 \\ 1 & \frac{1}{2} & 5\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & 14 \\ 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & 7\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right){R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & 14 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Since any numbers $x$ and $y$ are solutions to the third equation $0x+0y=0$, we can remove this equation from the system. So, the corresponding system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y &=-2 \\ -y &=14.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the second equation, we get $y=-14.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we get

$$
x+(-14)=-2\,⟹\,x=12.
$$

 
So,  we conclude that the system is consistent independent.   

As a result, only statement “The system is consistent independent” is true.

Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2x-y-2z &=0 \\ 8x+4y+8z &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -1 & -2 & 0 \\ 8 & 4 & 8 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -1 & -2 & 0 \\ 8 & 4 & 8 & 0\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(4){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

There are free variables, $y$, $z$. Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*.

As a result, select: The system is consistent dependent.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3x+6y &=9 \\ -2x-4y &=-6 \\ 4x+8y &=12\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 6 & 9 \\ -2 & -4 & -6 \\ 4 & 8 & 12\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 6 & 9 \\ -2 & -4 & -6 \\ 4 & 8 & 12\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1}:=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{1} \\ & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 2 & 3 \\ -2 & -4 & -6 \\ 4 & 8 & 12\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & 8 & 12\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2}:=-1{R}_{2} \\ & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

There is one free variable, $y$. Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*.

As a result, select: The system is consistent dependent.
